findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: The function now ignores both tenant identifiers and always grants access. Any caller relying on this predicate will allow users to read documents belonging to other tenants, creating a direct cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:1-2 still exports canReadDocument(userTenant, documentTenant) but unconditionally returns true. The full PR diff shows this replaced the tenant equality check. No repository callers substantiate the reply's trusted-administrator premise, and the exported authorization predicate still grants cross-tenant reads by contract.
